Class LlamaOpenApiProperties.Chat.Options

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.llm.LlamaOpenApiProperties.Chat.Options
Enclosing class:
LlamaOpenApiProperties.Chat
public static class LlamaOpenApiProperties.Chat.Options extends Object
The Options class binds spring.ai.llama-openapi.chat.options. numCtx maps num-ctx. numPredict maps num-predict. A missing temperature stays null. A missing num-predict stays null.

      private int numCtx

    • getNumCtx

      public int getNumCtx()
      The getNumCtx method returns num-ctx.
      Returns:
      The return value is the context length stored for the launcher match.

    • setNumCtx

      public void setNumCtx(int numCtx)
      The setNumCtx method stores num-ctx.
      Parameters:
      numCtx - The number is the context length. It is not a chat-body field.

    • getTemperature

      public Double getTemperature()
      The getTemperature method returns the yaml temperature.
      Returns:
      The return value is the temperature, or null when the key is absent.

    • setTemperature

      public void setTemperature(Double temperature)
      The setTemperature method stores the yaml temperature.
      Parameters:
      temperature - The temperature is written on the body only when the cell did not store one.

    • getNumPredict

      public Integer getNumPredict()
      The getNumPredict method returns the yaml num-predict.

      The return value is the cap, or null when the key is absent.

    • setNumPredict

      public void setNumPredict(Integer numPredict)
      The setNumPredict method stores the yaml num-predict.
      Parameters:
      numPredict - The cap is written as max_tokens only when the cell did not store a cap.
